summary.headline: Seven Climes and Southern Constellations
summary.text: Descriptions of Canis Major, Argo Navis, Corvus, Centaurus, and Piscis Austrinus, including star counts, named stars, and related constellational figures. Chapter twenty-four explains the seven climes, the inhabited quarter of Earth, equator, surrounding ocean, and parasang boundaries.
